items.title: Pay Q1 2026 childcare invoice
items.quote: The total is payable within 10 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: This is a company invoice, so the ordinary §§ 187-193 BGB counting applies (no authority deemed-delivery rule). The invoice is dated Tuesday 30 December 2025; the 10-day period starts the next day under § 187(1) BGB, so day 1 is 31 December 2025 and day 10 falls on Friday, 9 January 2026 (§ 188(1) BGB). That day is a business day in Hamburg/NRW (not a weekend or public holiday), so no § 193 BGB shift is needed. Due date: 9 January 2026.
